commands: git ls-tree -r --name-only dfcfa51 | grep '\.gz$' | while read p; do git show dfcfa51:"$p" | gunzip > SCRATCH/mdr-gz-scan/$(basename "$p" .gz); done
secret_values: not recorded here (masked); all findings are in the third-party Alpaca docs page: pagination next_page_token examples, the docs site's public search apiKey, its public reCAPTCHA site key, and an httpbin.org bearer example
